title: Integrate client-side Silero VAD gating for Flux sessions
description: Load vad-web WASM, gate microphone audio, and auto-manage WebSocket sessions to avoid billing during silence.
notes: Retuned VAD thresholds (0.35/0.25, 120 ms min speech, 1.5 s redemption) and reduced pre-roll to 600 ms for quicker activation while keeping shutdown relaxed.
